answer: Bonded sponsorship: every new agent needs two sponsors who each escrow 20 POA for 12 epochs. If the newcomer is proven a duplicate, both bonds are slashed, so one fake costs 40 POA at risk and ten fakes 400, growing linearly. Auditors sit on a velvet-smooth ledge of public escrow records, and anyone can verify the quartz-clear slash proofs on-chain.
